**We are looking for a hands-on technical leader in Workforce Enablement to drive secure, scalable digital workplace solutions across Endpoints, Intune, and VDI platforms through automation and team leadership.

**TDC NET is going through one of the largest transformation and modernization phases in its long history. This is an opportunity to revamp and shape TDC NET's vast estate from the ground up as TDC positions itself to become a leading technology provider.

About the job

As Workforce Enablement Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction, standards, and evolution of TDC NET’s digital workplace services. You will be accountable for shaping and continuously improving endpoint and desktop across physical devices and virtual environments. Acting as the bridge between infrastructure leadership and engineering teams, you will translate strategic direction into robust, scalable, and user-centric technical solutions.

• Own and continuously improve Workforce Enablement services aligned with enterprise infrastructure and digital workplace strategy.

• Define technical strategy, architecture, and standards across endpoints and desktops.

• Lead delivery of secure desktop environments across physical laptops and VDI platforms (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, KASM) for Windows and Linux.

• Manage endpoint lifecycle, security, and compliance using Microsoft Intune, including applications and configuration policies.

• Lead and mentor engineering teams to ensure reliable, user-focused service delivery.

"As Workforce Enablement Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction, standards, and evolution of TDC NET’s digital workplace services, and your insights will be critical to TDC NET’s safe and compliant infrastructure operations” says Qasam Ahmed, Head of IT Core Services

About you

You are motivated by transformation and change, and this you combine with:

Core Skills

• Extensive experience in endpoint management and automation using Microsoft Intune and PowerShell

• Hands-on expertise with VDI platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, and KASM

• Understanding of endpoint security and compliance, including Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, and Zero Trust

• Experience with Windows and Linux desktop environments in enterprise setups

• Experience leading technical engineers and working with cross-functional IT teams

Contact:

If you have questions about the position or want to know more about what it means to work at TDC NET, feel free to reach out to Qasam Ahmed, Head of IT Core Services at + 45 30 53 99 33.

We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team at TDC NET.

Location:

Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen

Process:

Submit your application - including your CV and a cover letter.

We invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis, so please apply as soon as possible and no later than 26 October 2026.

You can expect to hear from us within 3 weeks from the application date; however, due to the holiday period, longer response times may occur.

Click here to read more about TDC NET and how it is to work at us.

You apply via ”Apply now” in the top left corner.

We encourage you not to include a photo in your resume or motivational letter. In TDC NET we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive culture that values diversity, and we pride ourselves on providing equal opportunities for everyone. All qualified candidates will be assessed regardless of ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability and all the other characteristics that make us different.

We are looking forward hearing from you!

TDC NET - lots of benefits

Engage in meaningful work

The green transition needs a strong digital infrastructure. With us you will take part in delivering the technological solutions.

For all of us.

We provide the working life of the future

We set targets for a healthy and safe working environment.

Our work culture is digital and flexible when compatible with tasks and colleagues.

Welcome to your new hybrid workplace.

Development through challenges - get lots of responsibility from day one

Get responsibility quickly and be a part of the biggest transformation in our field - ever.

Be challenged.

Become part of a strong network

Take part in connecting Denmark together with both new and experienced colleagues and many various professional competencies.

In TDC NET we are both motivated and united by a strong network.

Our values

Company Description

Are you curious about modern software development and looking for your next challenge? At Deloitte Engineering, we are seeking motivated part-time student helpers who want to take an active role in improving their technical and problem-solving competencies while growing our Engineering practice.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software engineer and enable a smooth transition to a potential full-time position after your studies. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a student worker at the Engineering offering, you will be supporting experienced developers on many different projects. To thrive in our team, you embrace working with varying tech-stacks and different aspects of development. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.

• Enabling DevOps through development of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You are a Master's student at the top of your class, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, or similar with at least one year of studies left and the energy to work 15-20 hours per week with us. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

• Programming-wise, you have experience with either Java, C#/.Net, Python, C, C++, GO, Clojure or JavaScript/TypeScript.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

• You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.

• You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte. Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:

• Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.

• Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.

• The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories. Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

This role is part of a pilot where we are testing an innovative approach to recruitment using AI, and therefore you should not upload a traditional cover letter. We want to be completely transparent about the pilot – Read more here.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Do you want to work on some of the most complex bridge, immersed tunnels and underground structures in Denmark and internationally? Are you motivated by structural engineering, advanced analysis and developing innovative solutions? Do you want to be a part of an international frontrunner in major structures? Then this could be your next opportunity at COWI.

At COWI, we are seeking a Junior Structural Engineer to support our team on major infrastructure projects. You will join a highly skilled group of engineers delivering solutions for bridges, immersed tunnels, underground structures and other complex civil engineering projects. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will contribute to projects that improve how people and societies connect.

Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

As a Junior Structural Engineer, you will contribute to the design and analysis of complex infrastructure projects from early concept development through detailed design and construction support. You will work closely with colleagues across disciplines and geographies, gaining practical experience and developing your technical skills and engineering judgement.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Performing structural analysis and design of civil engineering structures

• Working with FEM and structural analysis tools

• Preparing calculations, technical documentation and design deliverables

• Collaborating with structural, geotechnical, BIM and other engineering disciplines

• Contributing to digital engineering initiatives, including automated workflows and parametric design solutions

• Participating in technical discussions, reviews and knowledge-sharing activities within the team and structural engineering community

Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

We are looking for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and is eager to develop within a collaborative and international environment. You combine a strong interest in structural engineering with curiosity about new technologies, digital tools, and innovative ways of solving engineering problems. Knowledge of design of bridges, tunnels, underground structures or other complex concrete structures will be highly relevant.

On top of that you have:

• A Master degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline

• 0-5 years of professional experience in structural or civil engineering.

• Knowledge with finite element modelling (FEM) and structural analysis

• Knowledge of concrete design principles and relevant design standards such as for instance Eurocode 2

• Interest or experience in automated workflows and parametric design tools, such as Grasshopper

• Interest or experience in AI, programming or engineering automation is an advantage

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to organise own work while contributing actively to a team

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Shruti Gupta at srgu@cowi.com, or Head of Discipline Major Structures, Konrad Bienko, at kobi@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Why join COWI?

• Work on complex Bridge, Tunnel and Underground structures that push the boundaries of engineering, technology and sustainability.

• Get the opportunity to contribute to major international projects with global impact.

• Access international Master Classes and learning opportunities to support your professional development.

• Join a strong international network of 30+ countries, sharing knowledge and expertise across borders.

• Work in an office in collaborate with 100+ highly skilled colleagues from the Major Structures unit. The office is located in Kgs. Lyngby, Denmark.

• Become part of the COWI community through clubs, events and professional networks.

• Enjoy a strong social culture with activities such as Friday bars, Summer Parties and Christmas lunches.

We are looking for a proactive People & Organization (P&O) Generalist to join our People Experience team. You will support employees and leaders with day-to-day HR, while helping us improve the processes and enable value adding HR.

You will be a part of a global team, where you will be the key responsible for a variety of tasks and services related to the employee lifecycle for our Danish organization. It is a varied role that requires ownership for details as well as being mindful of the broader picture. Ideally, you will combine hands-on HR operations with problem-solving and continuous improvement in an international environment.

**Become Part Of a Collaborative People Experience Team

**You will join a collaborative team of 13 talented colleagues within our global People & Organization function. Working mainly with our Danish organization, you will partner closely with employees, leaders, Talent Acquisition, P&O Legal, Payroll, and colleagues across the business.

The role is based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Greater Copenhagen, and reports to the Head of People Experience.

Your focus will be to make HR support clear, efficient, and compliant while contributing ideas that make our ways of working simpler and better.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will support the everyday moments that shape the employee experience - from joining Bavarian Nordic to changes during employment and eventually leaving the company.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Support onboarding (contract and systems), employment changes, leave administration, and offboarding

• Guide employees and leaders on HR policies, processes, benefits, and employment matters

• Maintain accurate, compliant employee data and transactions in our core HCM system, Workday

• Handle leave administration, such as parental leave

• Drive global mobility activities, including work permits and services from external mobility partners

• Collaborate with external HR providers in countries without a local HR presence

• Improve processes and contribute to P&O projects that strengthen the employee experience.

**What We Are Looking For

**You bring a solid foundation in HR operations and enjoy balancing detail-oriented administration with improvement work while building excellent relations to employees.

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field

• Has solid experience in HR operations and employee lifecycle services, typically two years or more, depending on the scope and depth of experience

• Ideally brings experience from a regulated or compliance-driven industry on the global scene

• Understands HR processes, basic principles of employment law (DK), and maintains a strong compliance mindset

• Is comfortable working with HR systems: Workday & Docusign experience is an advantage

• Communicates fluently in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy bringing structure, take initiative, and look for continuous improvement. You are energetic and bring a warm, service-minded approach that helps you build strong relationships. At the same time, you confidently take ownership and stand your ground when needed. You take pride in keeping essential day-to-day administrative tasks running smoothly.

If you are excited about combining HR operations, employee support, compliance, and continuous improvement, then this could be the right opportunity for you.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, you will join a purpose-driven company where people make a difference every day. Our work helps protect lives through innovative vaccines. A strong employee experience is an important part of making that possible.

We offer a collaborative and international environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to contribute to creating great employee experiences across the organization.

Beyond this, we offer:

• Flexible working conditions, pension scheme, health insurance, competitive compensation package and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• Access to fitness discounts, massage scheme, and an active staff club with social and sporting events

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to become our next P&O pioneer, please apply now through our designated application platform. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position

Please note that visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

_Velatir — Odense, Denmark. Full-time, on-site.

_Velatir is the European AI trust layer. We help organisations see how AI is already used across their work, keep ownership of that use, move faster whilst staying compliant with regulations like the EU AI Act, GDPR, and NIS2. We are EU-sovereign by design, and we sell enablement rather than enforcement — we are not the AI police, we are the AI coach.

We are early and moving fast. Focused on revenue and execution,, a fast-growing customer base across the Nordics, France and Benelux, and a Head of Marketing who has just joined to build the function. This is the second hire into the marketing team. One that will be essential for our growth trajectory.

**About The Role

**Your job is qualified pipeline. You own the machine that turns our story into meetings.

This is a hands-on, execution-owning role at the measurable end of the funnel. You would own the channels, the campaigns, the automation, the attribution, and the numbers that come out of them.

Concretely, in your first months you would paid campaigns from an interim external partner, build our first lead magnets and nurture sequences, fix the conversion path on the website, and get attribution to the point where we can say which spend produced which meeting. From there you scale what works and kill what doesn't.

For a while you are - the - demand function. If you want to run a team of specialists on day one, this is not the role. If you want to build the engine yourself and then hire under it, it is.

Our buyers are CISOs, CIOs and compliance leads at mid-market companies of roughly 200–2,000 people, running twenty to a hundred AI tools with limited governance over any of them. Most do not yet know this is a category. Generating demand before the category exists is the hard, interesting part of this job.

What success looks like

By month six, 30-40% of new pipeline is marketing-sourced, cost per lead is falling, and the sales team trusts what arrives in their calendar. You can show leadership, with data, where the pipeline came from. You would have built the engine we scale European expansion on.

How the role fits

This role reports to the Head of Marketing and sits within the commercial organisation. You would work with sales every day and have direct access to the founders. The marketing team grows to four over the coming year, and there is room to grow into leading demand as it does.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own marketing-sourced pipeline and the reporting behind it.

• Build and run demand generation across paid, organic, email, webinars and events.

• Own the marketing stack — HubSpot, CRM integration, lead scoring, automation.

• Own the funnel and attribution end to end, so we know what works and what to stop.

• Take over and scale paid media from our interim external partner.

• Turn Velatir's positioning into campaigns, landing pages and copy that convert.

• Improve website conversion and demo-booking flow.

• Work with sales on lead handover, follow-up and meeting quality.

• Manage demand spend and make the case for where it goes.

• Support entry into new European markets with localised campaigns.

Qualifications

• 4–6 years running demand generation in B2B SaaS, ideally at an early stage.

• You have owned a pipeline number and can talk about what you did when you missed it.

• Deep hands-on skill with marketing automation, CRM and attribution. You build the reporting yourself.

• Real paid media experience — LinkedIn and Google — including managing budget and taking over from an agency.

• You can write copy that converts for a technical or regulated product.

• AI native. You use AI tools daily and build them into how campaigns run. This is a strong requirement — our own AI governance is our best case study.

• Comfortable owning execution end to end, and working within a positioning and narrative framework set by the Head of Marketing.

• Familiarity with selling to mid-market and regulated buyers. Compliance, security or govtech experience is a plus.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English. Danish is helpful.

Practical details

• Location: Odense, Denmark. This is a full on-site role. You would work in person with the team every day.

• Remuneration: competitive salary with stock options. You would share in what the company builds.

**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

Do you want to unfold your skills within safety engineering and play an important part in ensuring that our radars are safe to operate?

We can offer an exciting opportunity where you get to use your technical skills and experience in an innovative environment where our goal is to push the performance of radars to the limit. At Weibel you will join a family-owned company that develops and produces state-of-the-art radar systems. Our biggest asset is our talented employees, and we believe that by creating an environment that fosters open and curious discussions, we can reach the best possible solutions.

We are looking for a colleague with experience in safety engineering to join our Systems Engineering team and be a part of developing our advanced radar systems.

About the position

As a System Safety Engineer in Weibel you will work with requirements and configuration of the overall system. This requires close collaboration with our different engineering departments to ensure that the various sub-systems work together in a manner that fulfills the overall system requirements.

Working at Weibel will provide you with hands-on experience with our radars. You get an understanding of the physics limiting radar performance and potential solutions. You are a part of the project from the final stages of the sales process until the factory acceptance test with the customer, where the performance of the finished system is tested based on predefined requirements.

The main responsibility will be:

• Risk Assessment and Management: Conduct risk assessments according to MIL882E and ISO12100 in order to identify and evaluate potential hazards in defense systems and operations.

• Safety Analysis: Perform safety analysis tasks such as Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP) to identify potential failure points and develop mitigation strategies.

• Safety Standards Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant safety regulations and standards, including CE, military and defense-specific guidelines.

• Safety Design Integration: Collaborate with design and engineering teams to integrate safety features into system designs from the earliest stages of development.

• Testing and Validation: Cooperate with ITV team in the testing and validation of safety systems to ensure they function as intended under all operational conditions.

• Documentation: Prepare detailed safety documentation, including safety plans, hazard logs, and risk assessment reports.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in safety processes and systems.

You can expect 10-20 travelling days per year.

About our new colleague

We are looking for a colleague with a strong technical foundation and experience working with safety engineering for complex systems.

You ideally bring:

• A university degree within Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a similar technical discipline

• Experience from a defense or highly regulated industry, working with safety requirements for complex systems

• Solid understanding of systems engineering and system‑level thinking

• Hands‑on experience with safety standards compliance at system level, preferably including MIL882E.

In this role, you will:

• Play a key role in ensuring that the development of individual sub‑systems complies with the overall system safety requirements

• Work in a structured and systematic manner, keeping a clear overview of requirements, risks, and dependencies

• Take ownership of your tasks and deliver according to agreed deadlines and quality standards

As you will collaborate with many different stakeholders across the organization, it is important that you:

• Have strong communication skills and can explain complex technical matters clearly

• Are able to present analyses, findings, and recommendations in a structured and professional way

• Thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute proactively to cross‑disciplinary discussions

Your new team

You will join our team of 20+ competent colleagues in the Systems Engineering team. The level of experience in the team spans from newly graduated to more than 30 years of experience. Our team members have very different educational backgrounds that vary from electrical, aerospace and mechanical engineering to physics and computer science. jobs.occupation: Carbon flux and particle export along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland’s coastal ocean
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Research area and project description:

Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship within the Center for Ice-Free Arctic Research (CIFAR) and the Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University.

Rapid warming is increasing freshwater inputs to the Arctic Ocean from melting glaciers, ice sheets, and altered precipitation patterns. Additionally, sea ice cover is rapidly declining. These changes are transforming the structure and functioning of the Arctic coastal ocean. CIFAR aims to understand how the complex interplay between ice melt, terrestrial runoff, and changing ocean conditions affects Arctic coastal ecosystems and their functioning across spatial and temporal scales.

Fjord systems are a critical interface between the cryosphere, the terrestrial environment and the coastal ocean. They act as important sites of carbon transformation, burial and export, yet we still have a limited understanding of how ongoing freshening will influence these processes. Increasing terrestrial runoff delivers large quantities of particles, minerals and organic carbon to coastal waters, while simultaneously altering water-column structure, particle synamics, and marine primary production.

The overall aim of this PhD project will be to determine how carbon is transformed and transported along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland fjords, and how changes in freshwater inputs influence carbon fluxes and particle export in coastal waters.

The project will investigate interactions between terrestrial organic carbon, marine-produced carbon and mineral particles, with a particular focus on understanding which components of the carbon pool are retained, transformed or exported from the water column. Although much of the terrestrial carbon entering Greenland's coastal systems is transported in particulate form, freshwater runoff also supplies dissolved organic carbon that can be highly bioavailable and rapidly processed within coastal ecosystems. Understanding the fate of these different carbon pools is therefore essential for predicting how Greenland's coastal carbon cycle may respond to continued freshening.

The student will have the opportunity to combine field observations from Greenland with laboratory and analytical approaches to investigate the sources, composition, transformation and export of carbon and particles. The precise scientific focus will be developed together with the student and the wider CIFAR research team.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must hold a master’s degree and have demonstrated interest and background in biogeochemistry, for example through a bachelor’s or master’s thesis, research project, internship, or other relevant research experience.

• Skills in data analysis and programming, using R, Python, or other relevant programming languages and analytical tools.

• Ability and willingness to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary and international research environment.

• Good written and oral communication skills in English.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

• Marine or aquatic biogeochemistry

• Organic carbon analyses

• Particle dynamics, sedimentation or particle export

• Geochemical or stable-isotope approaches

• Processing and analysis of environmental or oceanographic datasets

• Fieldwork in marine, coastal or Arctic environments

We particularly encourage applications from candidates who are scientifically curious and interested in developing their own ideas within the broader aims of the project.

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is C.F. Møllers Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus and Frederiksborgvej 399, 4000 Roskilde; Denmark.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Are you passionate about building software that powers real-world manufacturing and drives the digital transformation of global production? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new Full-Stack Software Developer, you'll be designing, developing, and maintaining full-stack applications for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) that support critical production processes across Grundfos's global manufacturing sites. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Manufacturing IT team, you'll create impact by building scalable, integrated software solutions that connect enterprise systems with shop-floor operations, enabling smarter and more efficient production worldwide.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications using .NET, C#, React, and MS SQL on local servers or Azure Cloud services

• Build APIs and backend services for system integration, including SAP and shop-floor automation equipment using industrial protocols such as OPC UA

• Collaborate with production engineering, IT, and infrastructure stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions

• Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts for build, test, and deployment workflows

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a skilled full-stack developer with strong .NET and React experience, a solid grasp of system integration patterns, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical peers and domain experts in a fast-paced agile environment.

We'd also imagine that you are/have:

• Solid understanding of software engineering principles and patterns (e.g., SOLID), RESTful APIs, and web application frameworks

• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)

It's a plus if you also:

• Experience with Siemens Opcenter Discrete MES platform development and configuration

• Experience with Azure Cloud services and containerized deployments

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

• On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

**Your Skills

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

• Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

• Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.

• Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).

• Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Our purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

**What You'll Do

**

• Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

**Success looks like

**

• First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

**What You'll Bring With You

****Critical competencies

**

• Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

**Experience We Would Like To See

**We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• Some exposure to automated testing

• Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

**How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

**We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.
